Can\'t reach Wear OS: Google Play services with the Wearable API is needed
The face is chosen on the watch: long-press the current face, swipe to Sable, and tap it. To switch the top arc between Agenda Peek and World Clock, tap Edit on the face and pick the top slot.
Steps, heart rate and battery come from the watch itself. The phone never receives or stores them.
The arc fits up to %d. Enter removes a city.
Type a city or code (LDN, Tokyo…)
The count comes from Sable Hub, so it follows Hub\'s read, snooze and privacy settings. Notification access makes the watch update as soon as a message arrives.

The count comes from TenSeven Launcher\'s Hub when it is installed with the same signing key. Notification access makes the watch update as soon as a message arrives, and gives a plain count without TenSeven. Only counts leave the phone.
Sable Weather is used when it answers. The city below is the fallback, from Open-Meteo.
Weather comes from Open-Meteo for the city you pick. Only the city\'s coordinates are sent, never the phone\'s location.
The phone sends the watch only what the face shows: cities, the next event, a message count and the weather. It sends again when one of them changes, and every 15 minutes.
